tracks.title: 七點半校門口
tracks.subject: a young woman whose older sister paid her HK$8,000 school fees and would not take an IOU; with no money to repay, she walks her six-year-old niece to school at 7:30 every weekday for a year, ticking each trip on a fridge calendar, and when she finally brings the HK$8,000 the sister pushes it back and says the school runs aren't finished
